notes.title: Jungle Update - New Biome!
notes.notes:
Jungle! A new biome that appears into Project Summit! Intoducing nine new levels with different features!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39020962/08cbabb3c983e7cdf1e0c4efd886d144fba751e1.png[/img]

[b]Three types of terrain:[/b]
[list]
[*] Grass
[*] Rock
[*] Leaves
[/list]

[b]Three types of hazards:[/b]
[list]
[*] Carnivorous Plant
[*] Gorila
[*] Bamboo
[/list]

You can interact with each new element in different ways!

notes.title: Update - Pause Menu and Controls Screen
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]PAUSE MENU:
[/list]
Now players are able to pause the game using the letter "P" if they're using keyboard, or the "start" button if they're on a gamepad. Inside this PAUSE menu you'll be able to continue the game, restart the level, or go back to menu.

[list]
[*]CONTROLS SCREEN:
[/list]
Inside the SETTINGS, you can select the CONTROLS option and see the in-game controls for a character, whether you're playing with the keyboard or a gamepad.
